description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to register various services related to OrchardCore's shell management, including hosting, feature descriptors, feature validation, and profile rules.

methods.name: AddHostingShellServices
methods.description: Registers core shell hosting services and handlers for OrchardCore.

methods.name: AddAllFeaturesDescriptor
methods.description: Registers a scoped shell descriptor manager for all features.

methods.name: AddSetFeaturesDescriptor
methods.description: Registers a singleton shell descriptor manager for a specific set of features.

methods.name: AddNullFeatureProfilesService
methods.description: Registers a scoped null implementation of IFeatureProfilesService.

methods.name: ConfigureFeatureProfilesRuleOptions
methods.description: Configures rules for including or excluding feature profiles based on expressions.
